capabilities: Organize manuscript chapters in a project binder with statuses, synopses, and ordering
Write with focus mode, typography settings, and timed sprint sessions
Track word counts, goals, deadlines, and daily writing streaks
Cite source notes from the vault and export to PDF, DOCX, EPUB, and manuscript formats
Publish finished posts directly to WordPress
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile); Obsidian 1.13.0+ required; manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; fonts load from Google Fonts on first use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to structure a long-form manuscript, track writing goals and sprints, cite vault sources, or export a formatted manuscript, so writers must assemble several tools themselves.

relations.evidence: Right-click any folder in Notebook Navigator and choose Open in sidebar explorer (requires Notebook Navigator to be installed)
Requirement: Pandoc must be installed for PDF, DOCX, RTF, HTML, and EPUB export.

requires.name: Pandoc (and LaTeX or wkhtmltopdf) for PDF/DOCX/RTF/EPUB export

summary: Nonfiction writing suite with a project binder, focus and typography modes, sprint timer, word count goals, citations, manuscript export, and WordPress publishing.
